claim: Apple's June 2026 quarter cleared $110 billion in revenue.
summary: The claim refers to Apple's June 2026 quarter (Q3 FY2026, April-June 2026) revenue exceeding $110 billion. The model's knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, which predates this quarter and its earnings release (typically late July 2026). With current date 2026-10-28 but no access to post-cutoff data or tools, the assertion cannot be verified or contradicted from internal knowledge alone.
